operations.command: set -e; cd {{workspaceRoot}}; lpath=$(nix flake archive --json | jq -r '.inputs.lanzaboote.path'); grep -q autoGenerateKeys "$lpath/nix/modules/lanzaboote.nix"; grep -q autoEnrollKeys "$lpath/nix/modules/lanzaboote.nix"; grep -q inputs.lanzaboote nix/system/boot.nix; printf lanzaboote
